name: celgo-macrogate
instr:
**featuregate doesn't agree with the old flag checks**

We're moving flag targeting off our hand-written checks onto cel-go rules (featuregate), and yesterday we ran it in shadow for an hour of production lookups. The two disagree a lot more than they should. beta_dashboard gets switched on for people who aren't in any beta group, new_editor is wrong in both directions, and bulk_export is off for a bunch of org accounts that the old code lets in, some of those with "no such key" errors. The rules file, our loader, the profiles export and the shadow log are in /workdir/evidence.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, as a _test.go file in the package it exercises (say
cel/repro_test.go), that fails on the current code because of this problem (a real test
failure, not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own
from a clean checkout with just your test files added. It can read files from /workdir/evidence.

I doubt I'm the only one hitting this. Anything else that goes through that code is probably
wrong too, so please fix it at the source rather than special-casing my input. The fix belongs in
the library itself, not in the tests. CI runs the full test suite on every change,
